_about: AI web check for jobs the rules leave unclear (needs_review). Claude searches the web and must give an exact quote; the code checks the quote is really on the page before the job's status changes. Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env; without it the check is skipped with a note. `enabled` controls the daily run only: `jobhunter check` works either way. See src/jobhunter/ai_check.py.
_model: claude-opus-5-5 is the most careful (about $4 in / $20 out per million tokens). claude-sonnet-5 costs about half; claude-haiku-4-5 about a quarter.
_max_jobs_per_run: A cost cap. The rest wait for the next run or `jobhunter check`.
_max_page_tokens: How much of each fetched page is read. Pages are the biggest part of the cost.
